_comment: A world given over to water: a sea of it and rock running wet, flooded caves and drowned halls, and the
biomes, features and structures leaning to water — oceans and swamps, kelp and coral, drowned ruins. Offered,
yielding to the book: a deeper sea, and rain more of the time.
It absorbed `drowned`, whose watery sea is this word's sea half (retired.json).
